function: The mask property is used to hide an element (partially or fully) by masking or clipping the image at specific points:
syntax: mask-image: mask-image mask-mode mask-repeat mask-position mask-clip mask-origin mask-size mask-composite|initial|inherit;

defaults.Default value: none match-source repeat 0% 0% border-box border-box auto add

values.function: Specifies an image to be used as a mask layer for an element. Default value is none
Specifies whether the mask layer image should be treated as a luminance mask or as an alpha mask. Default value is match-source
Sets if/how a mask image will be repeated. Default value is repeat
Sets the starting position of a mask image (relative to the mask position area). Default value is 0% 0%
Specifies which area is affected by a mask image. Default value is border-box
Specifies the origin position (the mask position area) of a mask layer image. Default value is border- box
Specifies the size of the mask layer image. Default value is auto
Specifies a compositing operation used on the current mask layer with the mask layers below it. Default value is add
Sets this property to its default value. Read about initial
Inherits this property from its parent element. Read about inherit
